note: P4055 (Pro 16:33) — the lot is cast into the lap, but its every decision is from the LORD. (tul 'cast' = standalone.)

dims.v: providence — the lot's every decision is from the LORD
the one who casts the lot
the decision/outcome of the cast lot, which is wholly from the LORD
the divine decision behind apparent chance

mishpat (decision/judgement) — 'the lot is cast into the lap, but its every DECISION is from the LORD'; even what seems chance is God's decision. Divine sovereignty reaches into the roll of the dice. The read holds the human act (casting) under the divine outcome.
